from fractions import Fraction
import json


def nearest_even(value):
    sign = -1 if value < 0 else 1
    numerator, denominator = abs(value.numerator), value.denominator
    quotient, remainder = divmod(numerator, denominator)
    twice = remainder * 2
    if twice > denominator or (twice == denominator and quotient % 2):
        quotient += 1
    return sign * quotient


weights = [[Fraction(1, 2), Fraction(1, 4), Fraction(1, 8), Fraction(1, 8)],
           [Fraction(1, 8), Fraction(1, 2), Fraction(1, 4), Fraction(1, 8)]]
cases = []
for sign in [1, -1]:
    for row, gains in enumerate(weights):
        for mask in range(16):
            value = 0
            trace = []
            for bus, gain in enumerate(gains):
                product = gain * (sign * 34)
                value = nearest_even(value + (product if mask & (1 << bus)
                                               else nearest_even(product)))
                trace.append(value)
            cases.append(dict(sign=sign, row=row, fused_mask=mask,
                              trace_eta=trace, mixture_eta=value))
normal_cases = []
for magnitude in [float.fromhex('0x1.8p+0'), float.fromhex('0x1.fffffffffffacp+0')]:
    for sign in [1, -1]:
        exact_bus = Fraction.from_float(sign * magnitude)
        for row, gains in enumerate(weights):
            for mask in range(16):
                value = 0.0
                trace = []
                for bus, gain in enumerate(gains):
                    product = exact_bus * gain
                    term = product if mask & (1 << bus) else Fraction.from_float(float(product))
                    value = float(Fraction.from_float(value) + term)
                    trace.append(value.hex())
                assert value == sign * magnitude
                normal_cases.append(dict(bus_hex=(sign*magnitude).hex(), row=row,
                                         fused_mask=mask, trace_hex=trace,
                                         mixture_hex=value.hex()))
source_cases = []
for sign in [1, -1]:
    for mask in range(256):
        value = sign * 9
        for edge in range(8):
            product = Fraction(sign * 9, 16)
            value = nearest_even(value + (product if mask & (1 << edge)
                                           else nearest_even(product)))
        assert value == sign * 17
        source_cases.append(dict(sign=sign, fused_mask=mask, source_eta=value))
pairs = []
for sign in [1, -1]:
    first = [x for x in cases if x['sign'] == sign and x['row'] == 0]
    second = [x for x in cases if x['sign'] == sign and x['row'] == 1]
    outcomes = sorted({(a['mixture_eta'], b['mixture_eta']) for a in first for b in second})
    for left, right in outcomes:
        pairs.append(dict(sign=sign, mixture0_eta=left, mixture1_eta=right,
                          both_output_eta=left + right,
                          first_output_eta=left, second_output_eta=right))
print(json.dumps(dict(model='exact rational arithmetic; binary64 nearest ties-to-even',
                     tiny_cases=cases, normal_cases=normal_cases,
                     source_cases=source_cases, independently_permitted_tuples=pairs,
                     positive_outcomes=sorted({x['mixture_eta'] for x in cases
                                               if x['sign'] == 1}),
                     negative_outcomes=sorted({x['mixture_eta'] for x in cases
                                               if x['sign'] == -1})), indent=2))
